idea-plugin.name: UE Reflect Watch
idea-plugin.description:
Stop manually closing and reopening Unreal Editor every time you add a UPROPERTY.

UE Reflect Watch monitors your Unreal Engine C++ header files for reflection macro changes (UCLASS, UPROPERTY, UFUNCTION, USTRUCT, UENUM) and automatically closes the Unreal Editor, rebuilds the project, and relaunches the editor the moment it detects a change on save.

Live Coding cannot handle reflection table changes. This is a hard architectural limitation of how Unreal's macro system works. The restart is unavoidable — doing it manually every single time is not.

Features

  • Detects macro additions, removals, specifier changes, and variable/function name and type changes
  • Optional confirmation dialog before the editor is closed
  • Silent mode — suppress prompts and rebuild manually when ready
  • Live build output in the UE Reflect Watch tool window
  • Auto-relaunch of the Unreal Editor after a successful build
  • Engine path auto-detected from your .uproject file, with override option
  • Supports Windows and macOS

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin and restart Rider.
  2. Open your Unreal Engine project solution.
  3. Run the Initial Project Scan first.
    Go to Tools > UE Reflect Watch > Initial Project Scan and run it once. This builds a baseline of all existing macros in your project so the plugin knows what has changed on the next save. Without this step, the first save of every header file will look like all macros were just added, triggering false positive rebuild prompts.
  4. The UE Reflect Watch tool window appears at the bottom of Rider alongside the Terminal and Run tabs. All build output streams here in real time.
  5. Add a UPROPERTY to any header file and save with Ctrl+S. The plugin detects the change, asks if you have saved your work in the editor, and handles the rest automatically.

Engine Path

The plugin reads the EngineAssociation field from your .uproject file and constructs the default install path automatically (C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.x on Windows, /Users/Shared/Epic Games/UE_5.x on macOS). If your engine is installed elsewhere, set the override in File > Settings > Tools > UE Reflect Watch > Engine Path Override.

Settings

All options are available under File > Settings > Tools > UE Reflect Watch:

  • Silent Mode — suppress prompts on save; use Rebuild Now when ready
  • Auto Rebuild — rebuild automatically without prompting
  • Confirm Before Rebuild — ask whether you have saved your work first
  • Auto Relaunch Editor — relaunch the editor after a successful build
  • Kill Editor Grace Period — milliseconds to wait after closing the editor before building
  • Engine Path Override — override the default engine install path

Source code and issue tracker: github.com/Exoduz85/UEReflectWatch

Currently in beta. Use at your own risk.
